**3\. “WE GET THE DEAL” BRAND SECTION**

**Eyebrow:**

**WHY HELIOS1 CAPITAL**

**What Does “We Get the Deal” Actually Mean?**

A deal is more than a property and a requested loan amount.

We look at the complete picture: who the borrower is, what they have executed before, how the project is structured, where the real risks are, how those risks can be mitigated, and what needs to happen for the opportunity to succeed.

That deeper understanding allows us to evaluate deals with more context—and, when the fundamentals support it, structure around situations that may not fit a conventional lending box.

**Four Supporting Value Blocks:**

**01 — Understand the Borrower**

**We look beyond a single line on a résumé.**

Experience matters, but so does how an investor sources opportunities, manages risk, deploys capital, builds teams, executes projects, and solves problems.

---

**02 — Understand the Project**

**Property, budget, timeline, permits, construction, cash flow, and exit all connect.**

We evaluate the deal as a complete transaction rather than treating each component in isolation.

---

**03 — Structure Around Real Risk**

**Good underwriting is not about ignoring risk. It is about understanding it.**

We look for meaningful mitigants in the deal structure, contracts, borrower profile, collateral, liquidity, execution plan, and alignment among the parties involved.

---

**04 — Stay Close to the Deal**

**Direct communication matters when the transaction gets complicated.**

Our team stays engaged through evaluation, structuring, closing, and the next opportunity.

**CTA:**

**See How We Underwrite Differently**

**4\. LOAN PROGRAMS**

*Rather than long bullet lists on the homepage, I recommend short solution-oriented cards with links to dedicated landing pages.*

**Eyebrow:**

**FINANCING SOLUTIONS**

**Capital for the Way Real Estate Investors Actually Operate**

Whether you are acquiring, renovating, building, stabilizing, refinancing, or growing a portfolio, Helios1 Capital can support multiple stages of the investment lifecycle.

---

**CARD 1 — GROUND-UP CONSTRUCTION**

**Ground-Up Construction**

**Financing built around the project—from land and permits through construction and completion.**

For experienced investors, builders, and developers pursuing residential construction opportunities. We evaluate the complete project, including budget, borrower experience, leverage, construction plan, timeline, draws, and exit.

**Explore Ground-Up Financing**

---

**CARD 2 — FIX \+ FLIP**

**Fix & Flip**

**Capital for acquisition, renovation, and the next opportunity.**

Designed for investors acquiring residential properties that require renovation or repositioning. Helios1 Capital evaluates the purchase, rehab plan, borrower experience, project economics, and exit as one connected deal.

**Explore Fix & Flip Financing**

---

**CARD 3 — DSCR**

**DSCR Rental Loans**

**Long-term financing built around property performance.**

For investors buying, refinancing, or cash-out refinancing rental properties. DSCR financing focuses primarily on the property’s income-generating ability rather than traditional personal-income documentation.

**Available for eligible residential rental properties from 1 unit through larger rental portfolios and multifamily scenarios, subject to program guidelines and underwriting.**

**Explore DSCR Loans**

---

**CARD 4 — BRIDGE**

**Bridge Loans**

**Flexible capital when timing and execution matter.**

Short-term financing for acquisitions, transitions, repositioning, or situations where investors need to move before permanent financing is in place.

**Explore Bridge Financing**

---

**CARD 5 — MULTIFAMILY**

**Multi-Family**

**Financing for investors pursuing larger residential opportunities.**

Flexible solutions for eligible multifamily acquisitions, refinances, value-add opportunities, and transitional business plans.

**Explore Multi-Family Financing**

**Talk to Our Team**

**5\. SARATOGA CASE STUDY / PROOF SECTION**

Make this visually prominent.

**Eyebrow**

**THE DEAL BEHIND THE DEAL**

**When a Strong Borrower Didn’t Fit the Standard Box**

A strong borrower came to Helios1 Capital with a well-structured Ground-Up opportunity in Saratoga, CA—but no completed Ground-Up projects on title.

Instead of stopping there, Helios1 Capital looked deeper at the borrower’s experience, entitlement work, liquidity, project structure, and contractual risk protections.

**The Result**

Helios1 Capital found a path to financing where another lender had passed.

The first loan was structured with a 24-month term, followed by an additional $4M+ facility for the borrower’s second lot.

**That’s What We Mean by “We Get the Deal.”**

**Read the Saratoga Case Study**
